**GIMP 3.2** is the desktop image editor, rebuilt for arm64 iOS. It runs locally through xiOS: not a remote desktop and not a web wrapper.

- Standard GIMP toolbox, docks, layers, filters, and color tools
- Bundled brushes, plug-ins, and image-format support
- GTK3 desktop interface rendered through Wayland and Metal
- Touch, pointer, and hardware-keyboard input through xiOS

A compatible rootless jailbreak and a xiOS desktop flavor are required. Install `gimp-native` as well if you want a Home Screen launcher and its own iPadOS host window.

[More screenshots and port details](https://xios.maxleiter.com/apps/gimp)
